C03 (#44) author pass delivered as draft PR https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/pull/69 against `codex/existence-monograph`. It separates the full-mesh limit from subsequential extraction (`rem:ex-limits-fullmesh`), fixes the separation metric in the full-mesh bounds theorem, and makes the reflected-conjugate relation explicit. It adds the C03 ledger. For G06: C04's edge E4 is not produced by C03 (see `results/C03/findings.md` F6), and the vacuum is unique only for μ-a.e. character (F7). Independent C03 review is now needed. This is not a closure claim.
